verdict.rationale: Slate is an interactive terminal agent, so a headless/CI story is a fair question for it. The docs describe only TUI interaction: sessions, hotkeys, Tab-queueing and subagent cards. The `--dangerously-skip-permissions`/`--yolo` flag and allow/deny permission config only remove approval prompts. That is an adjacent control, not a documented non-interactive, headless or CI execution mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
